title: Bound source-side retiming and crossed reads
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Exact Δκ = 0, or 0% relative to conditional κ = 0.00364665195644 on #7334 at aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace with signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d.

Both literal engines exhaust 33,560 typed retiming cuts on eight frozen public source MOVE windows. 33,517 have the wrong chart. The other 43 are the same source-532 pair 44611/46018 and cross ADD198←205 at 44613. Moving ADD205←532 later would remove +1/4 of source532 from role198 at that read. An exact coordinate-27 separator annihilates all nine adjusted public donor rows and evaluates to +1/4 on the missing signed response. At all 43 late cuts role198 occupies chart 207, while the relocated source uses chart 127. Both scopes are exhausted, with zero unresolved.

One edit would reduce the complete 17-copy paid count from 110,519 to 110,502 with 22,461 productive positions unchanged. The compatible whole upper is 1.063823269504365 raw for the eight-window retime. The 43 late cuts share both paid debits, so their repair has one directed upper 0.118078219358088 raw. No added paid rank-one position fits either single edit. Verified savings are zero.

## Task and overlap

This refines #7111 on canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7365/#7366 test moved destinations. #7003 supplies the source-side commuting retime on an older word, and #7312 the earlier common-lift contact test. #7338 records the exact paid key and excludes it before its different protected/owned component support test. The current two-contact repair checks an adjusted donor bank at the old read and original-source availability at all the late coframed cuts.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12:

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-source-side-retime-crossed-read-bound/replay.py
    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-source-side-retime-crossed-read-bound

The Git-free replay regenerates eight pinned receipts and rejects altered price and word inputs. Local registered replay, committed source and mode checks, six navigation tests, and official Git-free export and replay passed. The branch reuses exact #7257 planner repair d2e54af81f9dda6487636b79d4964a2385d89b2b. No literal candidate or complete κ replay was triggered.

## Credit and open question

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact native word and caller, #7298 the directed tariff, and #7336/#7355 related public and owned donor methods. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging. Alternative source banks at the original ADD or a fully priced changed itinerary are separate questions.
